\section[\texorpdfstring{\ru{бегать} (bégat)}{бегать (bégat)}]{\ru{бегать} (bégat) — to run about, to jog}

\label{lesson:RU-C178-begat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Russian for to make up, then the Russian for to train.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ru{бегать}}
\textbf{\ru{бегать}} (\emph{bégat}) — \textquotedblleft{}to run about, to jog\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ru{бегать}} is the repeated-action partner of \emph{\ru{бежать}}, \textquotedblleft{}to run\textquotedblright{} (Vasmer): running about. Vasmer relates the root to Lithuanian \emph{bėgti}, \textquotedblleft{}to run\textquotedblright{}, and Greek \emph{phóbos}, \textquotedblleft{}flight\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}
